sentences.text:
The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction up concerned respondents to pay proper compensation along with interest to the petitioner for acquisition of his land appertaining to Khata No. 12, Plot Nos. 961, 965, 966, 967 & 970,
Mouza-Tow, P.S-Bundu, District-Ranchi which was acquired by the respondents for widening of NH-33.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the grandson of the recorded tenant of the said land-Late Gulab Singh.

The District Land Acquisition Officer, Ranchi-cum-Competent Authority under the National Highways Act, 1956 (the respondent No.4), in the process of acquisition of the said land, initiated L.A. Case No. 20/2010-11 and issued notice No. 283 dated 23.02.2011 in the name of Gulab Singh to produce the documents relating to the said land in support of his lawful claim over the same so as to receive compensation of Rs.88,95,896/- with respect to the said land as well as the structure standing over the same.

entities.label: RESPONDENT

1 the said land.

sentences.text: However, no amount of compensation has yet been paid to the petitioner/the lawful claimant, which has compelled him to prefer the present writ petition.
A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent Nos. 6 & 7 stating inter alia that the aforesaid claim of the petitioner can only be considered by the respondent No.4.

It has further been stated that the NHAI has already deposited a cumulative amount of Rs.6 Crore with the respondent No.4 for acquisition of the lands of the concerned Mouza as would be evident from letter No. 923 dated 18.02.2011.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of the prayer made by the petitioner in the present writ petition, without entering into the merit of the case
, the petitioner is given liberty to prefer a fresh representation in this regard before the respondent No.4.

On receipt of the said representation, the respondent No.4, after verifying the relevant records and on providing due opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and other concerned person(s), if so required,
shall take an appropriate informed decision in accordance with law within four weeks from the date of filing of the said representation.
The present writ petition is accordingly disposed of with the aforesaid liberty and direction.

Satish/- (RAJESH SHANKAR, J)
